validity.researcher_notes: Design of the right bank to left bank line is under way and due to finish by the end of 2026 according to two 2025 items. The sheet's length, diameters and 2027 start are not stated in any harvested citation. The designer is Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Tomsk, which may be the future owner.

fills.researcher_notes: tkgorod.ru item of 15 January 2025: design of the gas pipeline from the right bank of Bratsk to the left bank continues and the design work finishes by the end of 2026. The mayor says Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Tomsk is the designer. ogirk.ru item of 18 February 2025: archaeology checks are needed before the design documents are approved for the gas line in Bratsk. Two publishers agree that the line is still at the design stage in early 2025. The trk-bratsk.tv item of April 2024 and the irk.today item of March 2024 say the same.

The wiki cites the irk.today item of March 2024. It says the left bank gasification needs more field development by 2027. That is a target for gasification, not a start year for this pipeline. The tkgorod.ru item of January 2025 says design will finish by the end of 2026, so a 2027 start of operation looks doubtful. The value and ref stay as recorded.

The Gazprom Transgaz Tomsk history page cited for this length does not mention the proposed line or 43.6 km. The 2024 and 2025 news items give no length for the transfer line either, only more than 400 km of gas networks overall. The value and ref stay as recorded.
The irk.today item of March 2024 cited for the diameters gives no pipe sizes at all. No other citation gives them either. The value and ref stay as recorded.

The Gazprom Transgaz Tomsk history page cited for the owner does not mention this proposed line. The 2025 news items say Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Tomsk is designing the transfer line, so the lower-level owner may be that company. Nothing states ownership, so the value stays as recorded and the question is left open.
No harvested citation names an operator for the proposed line. Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Tomsk is named only as the designer. Not searched further this pass.

verifications.note: Проектные работы завершатся до конца следующего года

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The newest readable items are from January and February 2025 and say design is under way. Nothing newer is in the citations, and the design deadline of the end of 2026 has almost come. Left unclear for the regional batches.
